name: Inspect CPA Manager Plus
command:
rm -rf /tmp/cpamp-research && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/seakee/CPA-Manager-Plus.git /tmp/cpamp-research && printf '
== relevant files ==
' && find /tmp/cpamp-research -type f | grep -Ei '(usage|monitor|analytics|event|sqlite|database|request)' | head -240 && printf '
== usage references ==
' && grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'usage_events|UsageSummary|usage-service|usage analytics|usageAnalytics|event.*usage|aggregation|rollup' /tmp/cpamp-research | head -240
description: Clone and inspect CPA Manager Plus usage implementation
